SELECT member.id AS child_id, member.teeny_score, grade.grade_id, grade.grade_name, grade.bonus_rate, grade.loan_rate FROM T_MBR_INFO_M member INNER JOIN T_TNY_GRADE_A grade ON member.teeny_score BETWEEN grade.min_score AND grade.max_score WHERE member.id = #{childId} AND member.role = 'CHILD' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_DPT_PROD_M ( fin_co_no, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, name, interest_calculation_type, rate_1m, rate_3m, rate_6m, rate_12m, early_termination_rate, min_amount, max_amount, min_teeny_score, description, is_active ) VALUES ( #{financialCompanyCode}, #{financialProductCode}, #{financialCompanyName}, #{name}, #{interestCalculationType}, #{rate1m}, #{rate3m}, #{rate6m}, #{rate12m}, #{earlyTerminationRate}, #{minAmount}, #{maxAmount}, #{minTeenyScore}, #{description}, #{active} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kor_co_nm = VALUES(kor_co_nm), name = VALUES(name), interest_calculation_type = VALUES(interest_calculation_type), rate_1m = VALUES(rate_1m), rate_3m = VALUES(rate_3m), rate_6m = VALUES(rate_6m), rate_12m = VALUES(rate_12m), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO T_SVG_PROD_M ( fin_co_no, fin_prdt_cd, kor_co_nm, name, savings_type, interest_calculation_type, rate_1m, rate_3m, rate_6m, rate_12m, early_termination_rate, min_month_amount, max_month_amount, min_teeny_score, description, is_active ) VALUES ( #{financialCompanyCode}, #{financialProductCode}, #{financialCompanyName}, #{name}, #{savingsType}, #{interestCalculationType}, #{rate1m}, #{rate3m}, #{rate6m}, #{rate12m}, #{earlyTerminationRate}, #{minMonthAmount}, #{maxMonthAmount}, #{minTeenyScore}, #{description}, #{active} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kor_co_nm = VALUES(kor_co_nm), name = VALUES(name), savings_type = VALUES(savings_type), interest_calculation_type = VALUES(interest_calculation_type), rate_1m = VALUES(rate_1m), rate_3m = VALUES(rate_3m), rate_6m = VALUES(rate_6m), rate_12m = VALUES(rate_12m), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
